items.title: Rabbit
items.note: Entry, landing, crouch and exit retained; simplified the contour to preserve the blunt doodle identity.

items.title: Duck
items.note: Restored the near-frontal foreshortened bill in the third key; torso and feet remain planted.

items.title: Horse
items.note: Restored foreground rail masking while the muzzle descends toward hay.

items.title: Dog
items.note: Restored rear/left views in the first keys, preserving the angular dog and ground support.

items.title: Cat
items.note: Retained head-turn poses while simplifying the face to the selected polygon-eye doodle.

items.title: Butterfly
items.note: Removed invented wing spread and dense cell pattern; kept the folded wings and fingertip contact.

items.title: Bicycle
items.note: Restored the lower-row front-wheel crop while retaining crank/foot attachment.

items.title: Windmill
items.note: Retained the four-sail assembly and phase angles; simplified the sails into irregular paddles.

items.title: Helicopter
items.note: Restored the second key’s close-pass crop before the later recession.

items.title: Giraffe
items.note: Carried the earlier accepted still-key reconstruction; whole-skull turn remains understated.
